title: Tableau Prep Flow Flow Run Time p95
dataSources: Tableau Prep flow runs (`tableau:prep:flow`) and Backgrounder logs.
app: Tableau Prep Conductor flow-run events from the `workgroup` repository via DB Connect and Backgrounder logs via UF.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=tableau:prep:flow finish_code=0
| eval dur_s=round(run_time/1,2)
| stats avg(dur_s) as avg_s, p95(dur_s) as p95_s, count as runs by flow_name
| where p95_s>600
| sort - p95_s
description: Computes the 95th-percentile flow run time for each flow in Tableau Prep and flags the slowest, pointing owners at the specific content or jobs that need optimisation.
value: Tail latency, not the average, is what users feel; ranking Tableau Prep flows by p95 focuses tuning effort where it removes the most pain.
implementation: Ingest Tableau Prep timing data; schedule daily over a trailing week and review the slowest flows with their owners.
visualization: Table of flow by p95 flow run time, trend line.
grandmaExplanation: We measure how slow the worst cases are in Tableau Prep so the sluggish ones get fixed before people give up on them.
